To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a stochastic model to predict the power fluctuations in a von Karmann swirling flow.

we derived a stochastic model for the torque in swirling flows, that we showed how to predict the PDF of the injected power in the case of a constant torque forcing, that we tested our model against experimental data in von Karman flows and that we provided a physical interpretation of the model.
a simple Langevin stochastic model can be used to predict the fluctuations of injected energy in a von Karmann swirling flow.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an analytical model of the fluctuations of torque in von Karman devices.
the development of a stochastic model of the torques in von Kármán swirling flow.
the modeling of turbulent flows.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a simple stochastic model is able to reproduce the PDFs of the injected power in von Karman flow, with a good quantitative agreement.
the stochastic model is a good tool for describing the fluctuations of power in the von Karman device, and can be used to design a stochastic forcing in a wind turbine.
the stochastic model of the turbulent torque is a simple and effective tool to predict the fluctuations of injected energy in the case of von Karman swirling flows.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a Langevin process with a colored noise is a very simple model to describe a von Karman swirling turbulence.
a stochastic Langevin model can be used to describe the turbulent torque produced in a swirling flow.
a Langevin process with a colored noise allows to describe the dynamics of turbulent fluctuations in a von Karmann swirling flow, and can be used to predict the PDF of injected power fluctuations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PDF of injected power fluctuations in a swirling flow is a universal quantity that only depends on the ratio between the forcing time scale and the time scale of the turbulent flow.
, for the case of constant applied torque, the injected power fluctuation is reduced, and the PDF of the injected power is more peaked.
the PDF of injected power fluctuations can be predicted from the knowledge of the mean injected power and the variance of the velocity fluctuations.
